generate_tasks_from_folder: run a script to load Python task files from a source folder and save them as serialized binary files in a target folder
generate_tasks_single_pickle: run a script to group tasks by tiers and save them as compressed pickle files in the target folder
generate_tasks_with_eval_stats: run a script to load tasks with evaluation complexity statistics and save them as binary files
save_task_binary: create a function that serializes a Thrift task object and saves it as a binary file in the target folder
load_and_serialize_tasks: run a script to load tasks from a folder using phyre.loader and serialize them using concurrent thread execution
